title: The quantum loop algebra of $sl_2$ and $q$-Racah type bivariate functions
summary: A unified algebraic framework for two different six-parameter families of bivariate $q$-Racah type functions is given using the representation theory of the quantum loop algebra $\mathcal{L} U_q sl_2$ of $sl_2$. The starting point of the analysis is two left and right coideal subalgebras of $\mathcal{L} U_q sl_2$ and six commutative subalgebras, built from eight elements in $\mathcal{L} U_q sl_2 \otimes \mathcal{L} U_q sl_2$.
